svg.title: Request lifecycle — from a browser frame to a reply
svg.desc: Use case: any typed request (here make_move). The epoll thread never runs game code; a worker owns the connection while it decodes, the pipeline runs its stages in a fixed order, and one SocketMessageSink is created per dispatch and destroyed when it ends.
svg.text: Request lifecycle — from a browser frame to a reply

the pipeline runs its stages in a fixed order, and one SocketMessageSink is created per dispatch and destroyed when it ends.
